phase: Phase 6O - Neural Shortlist Screening and Top-Utility Alignment

route.route_a_reason_rejected: no k <= 6 reached strong exact or epsilon-near-best recall on common and expanded frozen evidence

targeted_relabeling.diagnostic_basis: O0 observed two-CRN top-candidate disagreement in 501 of 864 states

candidate_union.original_states: Phase 6L top-4 union Phase 6N top-4 union canonical fallback
candidate_union.new_states: Phase 6N top-4 union canonical fallback because frozen Phase 6L OOF is unavailable

targeted_relabeling.outcome_independent_stop_rule: complete every frozen union row for all three additional seeds; infrastructure failures may resume but outcomes cannot change scope
targeted_relabeling.label_merge: targeted candidates use the mean and empirical beats-fallback frequency across all five seeds; non-targeted candidates retain the original two-seed truth
targeted_relabeling.estimated_basis: 14358 additional continuations are 52.7 percent of Phase 6N continuation count, with only 35.1 percent of its forced repairs

model.architecture: Phase 6N candidate-conditioned pooler, fallback fusion, continuation head, and beats-fallback head

source_balancing.within_source_instance_weight: 1 / number of training instances in source
source_balancing.within_source_instance_state_weight: 1 / number of training states for that source-instance

noise_margin.candidate_noise: 1.4826 * median absolute deviation of available CRN advantages around their candidate median
noise_margin.fold_margin: training-fold 75th percentile of candidate_noise clipped to [0.0025, 0.03]
noise_margin.near_optimal_set: candidate mean advantage >= state maximum mean advantage - fold_margin
noise_margin.pair_filter: exclude pairs with absolute mean-advantage gap <= fold_margin

opportunity_weight.raw: max(state q90 advantage - q10 advantage, max advantage - fallback advantage, 0)
opportunity_weight.scale: training-fold median positive raw opportunity clipped to minimum 0.005
opportunity_weight.normalization: renormalize to mean one within each source-instance before multiplying source-balanced state weight

fold_scales.policy_temperature: training-fold median within-state advantage IQR clipped to [0.005, 0.05]
fold_scales.utility_scale: training-fold median positive state utility spread clipped to [0.005, 0.05]
fold_scales.regret_scale: training-fold median positive near-best-vs-rest gap clipped to [0.0025, 0.05]
fold_scales.huber_delta: training-fold median absolute deviation of candidate mean advantages clipped to [0.005, 0.05]

top_set_cross_entropy.target: uniform probability mass over training-fold noise-margin near-optimal set

near_best_vs_rest_regret_logistic.pairs: near-optimal candidates against candidates below the noise margin

inner_selection.method: symmetric two-way structural-fold validation for each outer fold and seed
inner_selection.direction_a: fit structural fold X and validate Y
inner_selection.epoch_rule: maximize mean selected lift, then maximize mean near-best hit rate, then minimize mean top-1 regret, then minimize joint loss, then choose earliest epoch
inner_selection.refit: use selected epoch count to fit both outer-training folds
